description: This file defines the NotesListView SwiftUI view for the notes listing screen in the app. It manages displaying a list of notes, searching, creating new notes, and navigating to note editing views.

classes.name: NotesListView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view displaying the list of notes with search, create, and navigation functionalities.

classes.name: SearchField
classes.description: A custom view representing the search input field.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: A view representing each note in the list, showing title, preview, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: FloatingActionButton
classes.description: A floating button to create a new note.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the visual structure and layout of the NotesListView, including list rendering, search, creation, and navigation.
